==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable through evolution from [[Illusionist (Betrayal)]] by getting 2,000 kills with him, and attaining 37.5% awakening (via Worthy Souls '''or''' sacrificing mythic units) to evolve.
{{EvolutionTable}}
(you will need 62.5% worthiness (125 worthy souls) as well as 5000 kills in order to get [[Illusionist (Fusion)]])
* To get Worthy Souls (each Worthy Soul has 0.5% awakening), you need to either clear Karakora Town - Act 6 (Legend Stage), or by sacrificing {{Rarity|Mythical}} units for 12.5% each.
